mentions.name: Rewindly
mentions.description: A screen recording tool that captures PC activity for configurable durations from 15 seconds to 1 hour and lets users review their recent on-screen activity, functioning as an instant replay for PC use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://rewindly.app, a tool which records the screen for 15s to 1h (configurable) and allows you to view your recent activity. It's basically instant replay for PC activity.
mentions.author: degecko
